inputs.text:
Wake up and look at what they are feeding us. They want you to believe the fairy tale that it is just an accidental "budget shortfall" forcing the elimination of over 70 positions in the South Portland School District. 

Do not fall for it. This isn't incompetence; it is a calculated, top-down demolition strategy orchestrated by the puppet masters behind the scenes. They use these manufactured crises to dismantle the system from within, playing the grieving parent and taxpayer game to manufacture consent for whatever total control agenda the hidden elites are really rolling out. When they claim it's just about money, that is your absolute proof that the real operation is being concealed right in front of our faces.
